title: Tamper-Evident Cash Bag Seal/ID Notation Record (EV005)
prompt:
1) Function: Capture a forensic-quality close-up photograph of a written record noting a tamper-evident cash bag seal/ID.
2) Scene / Composition: A single paper record sheet lies flat on a neutral, unbranded matte gray work surface, filling ~75% of the frame. The sheet contains a few handwritten lines and checkboxes, including one line labeled “Cash bag seal/ID:” followed by an alphanumeric entry, and adjacent fields such as date, time, and initials left blank or filled generically without real names. Include a small, plain millimeter scale card (no brand, no lab name) placed parallel to the bottom edge of the paper, occupying ~8% of the frame. Use raking light from the left to emphasize paper texture and pen indents without harsh shadows. No additional objects besides the paper and the scale.
3) Angle & Distance: Angle 10° from perpendicular (slight oblique), subject distance 0.45 m.
4) Optics & Technique: 50 mm lens, f/8, 1/125 s, ISO 200, white balance 5000 K; focus on the “Cash bag seal/ID” line with deep enough DOF to keep the full line and nearby fields legible; sharp, low-noise, true-to-life color.
5) Mandatory elements: English (en-US) form-style wording that includes the exact field label “Cash bag seal/ID:” with a clearly written fictitious alphanumeric code; a plain millimeter scale reference visible in-frame; no added annotations or arrows.
6) Negatives: No faces, hands, fingerprints, or people; no real names, signatures, or identifiable personal data; no logos, brands, letterhead, agency names, or official badges; no barcodes/QR codes; no case ID or evidence ID text printed on the paper; no timestamps embedded by camera UI; no additional props (pens, phones, envelopes); no glare, moiré, or extreme shadows; no collage or multi-panel layout.
7) Acceptance checklist:
- Single color photo showing one paper record and one plain mm scale on a neutral surface
- Raking light from left with visible paper texture and legible writing
- “Cash bag seal/ID:” field present with a fictitious alphanumeric entry
- No logos, real names, barcodes, or evidence/case identifiers visible
- Close-up, forensic-quality sharpness with minimal noise and accurate white balance
